headerDepartureTime._translationNote: As in, the time that the service is due to [depart].

headerDestinationAndRemarks._translationNote: Direct translation of 'to' and 'remarks' if possible, but translations of 'Destination' and 'notes' are also acceptable. Capitalise both words, and separate with a forward-slash (no space).

headerPlatformAndTrain._translationNote: Use whichever of platform/track is more commonly used in the relevant language. Capitalise both words, and separate with a forward-slash (no space).

serviceCancelled._translationNote: Capitalise as if it was the start of a sentence. Needs to work in combination with serviceReason below.

serviceReason._translationNote: Needs to work in combination with serviceCancelled above. An example of a reason that could follow is 'a fault on this train'.

noInfo._translationNote: Should not explicitly mention an app and/or website - keep it generically 'online'. Capitalise as a full sentence.
noInfo.fr: Merci de vous référer à l'horaire en ligne
noInfo.it: Si prega di consultare l'orario online

headerDestination._translationNote: Direct translation of 'to' if possible, but a translation of 'Destination' is also acceptable.

headerOrigin._translationNote: Direct translation of 'from' if possible, but a translation of 'Origin' is also acceptable.

headerPlatform._translationNote: Use whichever of platform/track is more commonly used in the relevant language.

headerNote._translationNote: This column states if a service is cancelled/delayed, and shows any other message related to it. Translation of 'remarks' is acceptable if there is no direct translation for 'note'. Please assume to be singular.

serviceCancelled._translationNote: Capitalise as if it was the start of a sentence.

serviceDelayedMins._translationNote: Although this will be used as a full sentence, keep it lowercase to match SBB's style. {min} will be an integer, assumed to be >1.

serviceDelayedIndefinitely._translationNote: Should be clear that the length of delay is unknown. Other similar words can be used if no direct translation for 'indefinitely'.
